diagnostics.message: tile 'analog_reg' has no logical binding: Analog regulation block. The manifest exposes only the pcr unit for power, clock and reset, which is not this block.
tile 'boot_rom_otp' has no logical binding: Merges boot storage and fuses; the manifest separates otp, boot_seq and qspi into distinct units.
tile 'cpu_cluster' has no logical binding: Prototype CPU-subsystem block that does not correspond to a single one of the fep, smp or rot units.
tile 'cpu_memory' has no logical binding: Prototype CPU-subsystem block. The manifest models three embedded processors (fep, smp, rot) plus tensor memory; this block matches none of them one-to-one.
tile 'hbm_phy' has no logical binding: The manifest declares six distinct HBM4E instances; this prototype geometry does not determine which instance each placed block is.
tile 'msa_array' has no logical binding: Metasurface analog internal. The manifest models the metasurface path as the off-die msic chip, with no on-die array unit.
tile 'msa_dac_array' has no logical binding: Metasurface analog internal with no modeled logical unit.
tile 'msa_memory' has no logical binding: Metasurface weight storage; not separable from the off-die msic chip in the current manifest.
tile 'msa_row_driver' has no logical binding: Metasurface analog internal with no modeled logical unit.
tile 'pcie_ctrl' has no logical binding: Per-lane PCIe controller slice with no distinct logical owner; the manifest models a port as one pcie_ep instance.
tile 'pcie_phy' has no logical binding: The manifest declares nine distinct pcie_ep port instances; the placed PCIe lane count and ordering here are prototype geometry, not an instance assignment.
tile 'rx16' has no logical binding: Per-lane RX receiver column. The manifest models optical RX as the single ovmm_rx unit and does not assign lanes to placed columns.
tile 'spacer' has no logical binding: Layout alignment spacer. It is not a physical component and must never acquire a logical binding.
tile 'tx16' has no logical binding: Per-lane TX driver column. The manifest models optical TX as the single ovmm_tx unit and does not assign lanes to placed columns.
192 physical leaves across tiles vpu_sram aggregate onto the single manifest instance u_vpu of t100.eic.bar0.vpu
51 physical leaves across tiles noc_bar, noc_post, noc_spine aggregate onto the single manifest instance u_noc_hs of t100.eic.bar0.noc_hs

id_semantics.bind.manifest: Repository-relative path of the external manifest that owns logical identity.
id_semantics.bind.path: Canonical logical component ID in that manifest, of the form <chip_set>.<chip>.<bar_or_block>.<unit>[.<sub_unit>...]. It is not a YAML lookup path. Prototype geometry does not prove a binding.
id_semantics.physical_id: Hierarchical physical placement identity, owned by this layout source.
id_semantics.unbound_reason: Why a physical leaf has no defensible logical owner; required when bind is null.

instances.unbound_reason: Layout alignment spacer. It is not a physical component and must never acquire a logical binding.
